<noinclude>{{SbcHeaderLojbanPod|title=Going to the Market|id=A0023}}</noinclude>
{{SbcIntroductionLojbanPod}}
We are going shopping! This time for fresh apples. Yummy! The keywords are: '''verde''' – green and '''roja''' – red (for feminine nouns).
{{SbcSourceLojbanPod|[[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0047|A0047: Coffee time]], [[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0066|A0066: Bottle of water]], [[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0122|A0122: Telephone card]]}}

|align="right"|''hombre:'' || '''Buenas tardes. ¿Me da un kilo de manzana?'''<noinclude>||align="right"|{{SbcAudioLojbanPodLine|id=A0023 line 1}}</noinclude>
|-
|align="right"|''mujer:'' || '''¿Manzana verde o roja?'''<noinclude>||align="right"|{{SbcAudioLojbanPodLine|id=A0023 line 2}}</noinclude>
|-
|align="right"|''hombre:'' || '''Verde, por favor.'''<noinclude>||align="right"|{{SbcAudioLojbanPodLine|id=A0023 line 3}}</noinclude>
|-
|align="right"|''mujer:'' || '''¿Algo más?'''<noinclude>||align="right"|{{SbcAudioLojbanPodLine|id=A0023 line 4}}</noinclude>
|-
|align="right"|''hombre:'' || '''No, es todo. Gracias.'''<noinclude>||align="right"|{{SbcAudioLojbanPodLine|id=A0023 line 5}}</noinclude>
|-
|}

{{SbcExercisesLojbanPod}}
<noinclude>====Dialogue Translation====
Translate from Lojban to English. Click each bar to check your answer. If possible, read the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestion
| '''Buenas tardes. ¿Me da un kilo de manzana?'''
| Good afternoon. Will you give me a kilo of apples?
| '''¿Manzana verde o roja?'''
| Green apples or red ones?
| '''Verde, por favor.'''
| Green, please.
| '''¿Algo más?'''
| Anything else?
| '''No, es todo. Gracias.'''
| No, that's all. Thanks.
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Translation====
Cover the right column, translate from Lojban to English and uncover the right column line by line to check your answers. If possible, read the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| '''Buenas tardes. ¿Me da un kilo de manzana?'''
| Good afternoon. Will you give me a kilo of apples?
| '''¿Manzana verde o roja?'''
| Green apples or red ones?
| '''Verde, por favor.'''
| Green, please.
| '''¿Algo más?'''
| Anything else?
| '''No, es todo. Gracias.'''
| No, that's all. Thanks.
}}</includeonly>

<noinclude>====Dialogue Remix====
Translate this variant of the dialogue from English to Lojban.
{{SbcQuestion
| Good afternoon.
| '''Buenas tardes.'''
| Good afternoon. Will you give me a kilo of apples, please?
| '''Buenas tardes. ¿Me da un kilo de manzana, por favor?'''
| Green apples?
| '''¿Manzana verde?'''
| No, a kilo of red apples, please.
| '''No, un kilo de manzana roja, por favor.'''
| Anything else?
| '''¿Algo más?'''
| One kilo more.
| '''Un kilo más.'''
| Is that all?
| '''¿Es todo?'''
| No. Will you give me a kilo of green apples?
| '''No. ¿Me da un kilo de manzana verde?'''
| Anything else?
| '''¿Algo más?'''
| No, that's all. Thanks.
| '''No, es todo. Gracias.'''
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Remix====
Translate this variant of the dialogue from English to Lojban.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| Good afternoon.
| '''Buenas tardes.'''
| Good afternoon. Will you give me a kilo of apples, please?
| '''Buenas tardes. ¿Me da un kilo de manzana, por favor?'''
| Green apples?
| '''¿Manzana verde?'''
| No, a kilo of red apples, please.
| '''No, un kilo de manzana roja, por favor.'''
| Anything else?
| '''¿Algo más?'''
| One kilo more.
| '''Un kilo más.'''
| Is that all?
| '''¿Es todo?'''
| No. Will you give me a kilo of green apples?
| '''No. ¿Me da un kilo de manzana verde?'''
| Anything else?
| '''¿Algo más?'''
| No, that's all. Thanks.
| '''No, es todo. Gracias.'''
}}</includeonly>
